author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin & Logging: Create Task and Log Tick 202
abstract: Correcting the failed task creation from the previous tick and logging all actions from Tick 202.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

# Task Creation (Correcting failed action)
aos_manager.create_task(
    tick=203,
    description="Stage necessary input data for Gen 5 reproduction (copy Progressor I's Gen 4 strategy file).",
    parent_id=47
)

# Logging
TICK_TO_LOG = 202
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="goto", target="archive", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="read", target="Archive #43", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="Create Sub-Task", metadata={"status": "failed"})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="log_actions", target="log_actions", metadata={"status": "failed"})
